name: HandoffReattach - Dense
description: The one-row form, used on the finished-plan screen. MapScreen is an h-screen flex column and this strip is shrink-0, so every row it takes is a row the summary loses - and the summary is the whole reason someone opens a finished map. The heading goes, both commands truncate onto one row, and the two copy buttons survive: a shorter strip that dropped a command would be smaller and no longer do its job. Compare against Default to see exactly what the screen buys back.
